text:
Predicates:
OccursIn(x, y) ::: x occurs in y.
Get(x, y) ::: x gets y.
Virus(x) ::: x is a virus.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Symptom(x, y) ::: x has symptom y.
Premises:
∀x ∀y ((Virus(monkeypoxVirus) ∧ OccursIn(monkeypoxVirus, x) ∧ Being(x)) → Get(x, monkeypox)) ::: When the Monkeypox virus occurs in a being, it may get Monkeypox.
∃x (Animal(x) ∧ OccursIn(monkeypoxVirus, x)) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in certain animals.
∀x (Human(x) → Mammal(x)) ::: Humans are mammals.
∀x (Mammal(x) → Animal(x)) ::: Mammals are animals.
Symptom(monkeypox, fever) ∧ Symptom(monkeypox, headache) ∧ Symptom(monkeypox, musclePains) ∧ Symptom(monkeypox, tiredness) ::: Symptoms of Monkeypox include fever, headache, muscle pains, and tiredness.
∀x (Get(x, flu) → Feel(x, tired)) ::: People feel tired when they get the flu.
Conclusion:
¬∃x Get(x, flu) ::: No one gets the flu.
